title: Bump peer-ai-eslint-config to next.16, and park TS-08 until the rebuild
goal: next.16 fixes Peer AI #235: a reporting-only rule no longer replaces an enforced rule sharing the same ESLint rule. This project has that shape, so TS-08's 400-line limit has never been applied to a .tsx file while doctor and CONTEXT recorded it as enforced and passing. With the fix, home-screen.tsx (500 counted lines) and onboarding.tsx (660) break it. The owner's decision is to park TS-08 until the screens are rebuilt, on the reason already accepted for TS-07 and REACT-03.
acceptance: Given peer-ai-eslint-config at 1.0.0-next.16, when npm run verify runs, then lint is green with no error, and the two files over 400 lines are reported rather than ignored
Given the deferral, when peer-ai doctor runs, then TS-08 is listed as reporting only until ITEM-2, with the owner named and the two files named in the reason
Given REACT-03's existing deferral reason claims TS-08 passes in source, when this lands, then that sentence is corrected, because it was true only while the rule was not being applied
Given a file is added over 400 lines after this, when lint runs, then it is reported rather than silently passing, which is what the bug prevented
next: Read what this item needs, then plan it.
